reproduce.title: Replay issue #50828
prerequisites: Use a clean ZoomIt launch with the default UI configuration.
steps: Open the ZoomIt UI identified by the issue.
Scroll continuously to the bottom of the page or settings surface.
Pause at the bottom and observe whether the content or bottom section oscillates vertically.
Repeat after reopening ZoomIt to determine whether the behavior is deterministic.
reproduce.expected_result: The bottom of the ZoomIt UI reaches a stable scroll position without visible jitter.
